patch_description: Replace the CRZ-augmented design with a structure that splits the complete CZ graph into two halves (4+3 matchings) with a collective RX mid-block rotation between them. This creates a phase-amplitude-phase sandwich that enables richer interference patterns. The design uses 5 shared parameters per block (prep_ry, prep_rz, mid_rx, decode_ry, decode_rx) = 32 total params. The mid-block rotation is on a different axis (RX) from the preparation (RY, RZ) and decoding (RY, RX), ensuring all three rotation axes are used within each block for full single-qubit expressivity.
